awin-celsius-herbs-dermveda-natural-fung: Dermveda® Natural Fungal Acne Relief Cream

Fungal acne, often mistaken for traditional acne, is a common but misunderstood skin condition. Unlike bacterial acne, fungal acne is caused by an overgrowth of yeast called Malassezia (formerly known as Pityrosporum), which leads to small, itchy, uniform bumps, often appearing on the forehead, chest, and upper back. This condition, scientifically known as Malassezia folliculitis, requires specific treatment methods that differ from those used for bacterial acne. To effectively treat fungal acne, it is crucial to consider individual skin types. The skin's characteristics—whether oily, dry, sensitive, or combination—play a key role in determining the best treatment approach.
